entities.name: Nottingham Prognostic Index
observations: Conventional three-tier NPI classification was directly compared with immunohistochemical marker expression in a human breast carcinoma NST cohort.
NPI-associated expression patterns may partly reflect its embedded tumor size, grade, and nodal-status components.

entities.name: PMID:25082024
observations: In 120 human breast carcinoma NST cases, ER and PR positivity decreased with increasing NPI; between-group differences were significant at P<0.01.
HER2/neu overexpression increased with NPI and differed significantly at P=0.01.
High Ki-67 increased with NPI and low Ki-67 was concentrated in the good-NPI group; both patterns had P<0.01.
Bcl-2 was more frequent in good/moderate NPI groups; p53 direction and significance were not confirmed in the available record.

entities.name: Estrogen receptor
observations: ER positivity was more frequent in good/moderate NPI groups than in the poor group in PMID:25082024; P<0.01.

entities.name: Progesterone receptor
observations: PR positivity was more frequent in good/moderate NPI groups than in the poor group in PMID:25082024; P<0.01.

entities.name: HER2/neu
observations: HER2/neu overexpression was more frequent in moderate/poor NPI groups and increased with NPI numerical value; P=0.01 in PMID:25082024.

entities.name: Ki-67
observations: High Ki-67 increased with NPI value, while low Ki-67 was concentrated in the good-NPI group; both reported patterns had P<0.01 in PMID:25082024.

entities.name: Bcl-2
observations: Bcl-2 was reported more frequently in good/moderate NPI groups in PMID:25082024, but a marker-specific p-value was not available.
In PMID:16638854, Bcl-2 retained prognostic significance independent of NPI; validation HR 0.83, P=0.018.

entities.name: CD74
observations: CD74 IHC was significantly higher in tumors with higher NPI scores in a separate human study of 160 invasive breast carcinomas; PMID:27834468.

entities.name: PMID:27834468
observations: In 160 invasive breast carcinomas, CD74 IHC was significantly higher with higher NPI scores; receptor markers were used for immunoprofile classification rather than direct NPI-group expression comparisons.

entities.name: PMID:16638854
observations: A 930-case IHC study did not directly compare marker-expression frequencies across NPI categories; Bcl-2 added prognostic information independently of NPI.
